content:
It was a pleasure to welcome Ms. Kshama Bharti, Advocate as a new member of my Chamber.

The occasion was marked by Band ceremony and refreshments, making the beginning of this professional association truly memorable.

I believe that every new association brings fresh energy, new perspectives and an opportunity to grow together. I look forward to Ms. Kshama Bharti’s valuable contribution and wish her a successful and rewarding journey in the legal profession.
comment: Strong professional chambers are often built not just on legal expertise but on mentorship, knowledge exchange and the culture that helps younger advocates develop sound professional judgment.
